scope.art_basis: Original generic electric kickboard: battery deck, traction ribs, small motor-hub wheels, mudguards, folding stem, cable/brake, grips, throttle, speed display and reflectors. No commercial model or surveyed dimensions claim.
scope.ride_basis: E rental/dismount/return with actual native body acceleration, steering, braking, source/public-road support, private and door-clearance rejection. The Seoul Plaza dock is laterally offset 2.15 m from the bicycle departure line, preserving both physical departure corridors. Not a statement about real legal riding access.
scope.distribution_basis: Eight geographically dispersed authored game docks per vehicle kind. Original plaza and stonewall station records retained without field changes. Six added pairs use existing source-bound exterior routes with separate departure paths; not official rental locations or live inventory.
